title: OrderEase
description: Full-stack car rental system built as a final course project. Includes user registration/login, car browsing with filters, single-rental restrictions, and real-time availability updates. Features paginated search, an admin dashboard with visualized data (graphs, charts), and basic user/car management. Built with PHP & MySQL — now archived as I’ve moved to the MERN stack.

title: Food App
description: A recipe discovery app with an intuitive interface for browsing dishes, viewing ingredients, and following step-by-step cooking guides. Designed to make the culinary journey easy, informative, and enjoyable.

title: Adze Movies
description: A lightweight movie browser that lets users search by title, filter by categories, and save or unsave favorite films. Built for speed and simplicity — ideal for practicing dynamic UI and state management.
